title: 字典序排数
summary: 按十进制字符串的字典序返回一到 n 的所有整数，要求线性时间和常量额外空间。
insight: 整数隐式组成十叉字典树：优先乘十深入子节点，无法深入时回退尾部九或越界分支再加一。
pitfalls: 不能实际把所有数转字符串排序
遇到尾数九要连续回退
current+1 超过 n 时也要回退

solutions.title: 隐式十叉树先序遍历
solutions.idea: 用当前数字模拟字典树中的深入、回退和访问下一个兄弟。
steps: 若 current*10<=n 则深入乘十
否则在尾九或越界时除十回退，再 current++

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> lexicalOrder(int n){List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>(n);int current=1;for(int count=0;count<n;count++){answer.add(current);if((long)current*10<=n)current*=10;else{while(current%10==9||current+1>n)current/=10;current++;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun lexicalOrder(n:Int):List<Int>{val answer=ArrayList<Int>(n);var current=1;repeat(n){answer.add(current);if(current.toLong()*10<=n)current*=10 else{while(current%10==9||current+1>n)current/=10;current++}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> lexicalOrder(int n){vector<int> answer;answer.reserve(n);int current=1;for(int count=0;count<n;++count){answer.push_back(current);if((long long)current*10<=n)current*=10;else{while(current%10==9||current+1>n)current/=10;++current;}}return answer;} };
